assets.name: barn-burning-overlay
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent production painted burning-barn overlay for a 2D beat-em-up game. EDIT TARGET: attached 1024x768 barn crop, whose building baseline is y=714 and gable apex is exactly (518,169). This is an architectural continuity edit, not a new composition. Keep the canvas 1024x768 and keep all roof lines, wall edges, open door outlines, hinges, barrel contours, lanterns and fence posts in their EXACT existing pixel positions. Same side-on perspective. Do not move, resize, distort, widen, tilt, rebuild or reframe ANY architecture. Preserve alpha outside the existing scenery except new painted flame silhouettes.

Change only the big barn so it is visibly burning: charred near-black edges on the roof shingles and door beams, small sharp ember cracks, orange fire visible INSIDE the upper hayloft and large ground-level doorway, clearly hand-painted curling flame tongues escaping the eaves along the existing roof line, and sparse hard-edged red-orange embers. Flames are crisp tapered cel-painted tongues with defined yellow inner shapes and burnt-orange outer shapes; no luminous round blobs, no bloom, no soft orange cloud. Keep fire sparse enough to see the old roof and doorway shapes under it. Grey smoke is optional, at most one very small grey wisp above the roof, transparent around it. Top 60 pixels must remain wholly empty transparent so a game banner remains readable. Existing barn boards should look scorched and orange-lit, especially inside the openings; LEFT EDGE stable, hay and fence, RIGHT EDGE shed and fence must stay visually unchanged. No characters, animals, rain streaks, ground below y=724, text, frames, labels or watermark. Same confident fine dark-brown ink, detailed hand-painted wood and slate texture, grounded cel shading as reference. Output the whole edited crop with genuinely transparent background, not a checkerboard painted into the image.

assets.name: barn-flame-roof
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animation sprite strip, four separately painted frames of a small curling roof fire. Create a single transparent image 1536x1024 containing EXACTLY FOUR equal 384x1024 cells in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW. Every cell contains one hand-painted fire sprite, centered at x=192 within its cell, fixed fire BASELINE y=760. Each fire silhouette fits x=40..344 and y=330..760 inside its cell. All other pixels genuine alpha. No architecture, wood, floor, base, smoke, text, numbers, dividing lines, cell borders, labels, or watermark.

Style: HD inked 2D fighting-game VFX, sharp tapered hand-painted flame tongues, dark burnt orange outer contour, orange midtones and small pale-gold/yellow cores, clean 2-3-tone cel shapes with subtle brush texture, no bloom, soft blobs, rings or gradients. It should sit on a rainy-dusk wooden barn roof and be much smaller than the barn. Draw a 4-frame seamless cyclical animation, successive instants of the SAME fire with materially DIFFERENT newly painted internal curls and tongues. Frame 1: main tongue curls left, right little tongue just lifting. Frame 2: left tongue narrows and snaps into two tapered licks as central tongue rises. Frame 3: central tongue curls right, left small lick regrows. Frame 4: central tongue rolls down and left while right tongue shortens, ready for frame 1. Maintain same stable width and foot point, comparable overall volume and palette. Keep all fire silhouettes and airborne sparks entirely within the specified safe bounds of each cell. Do not rotate, mirror, stretch, recolor, translate or reuse a single drawing as the other frames; genuinely paint each moment. Real transparent background, no painted checkerboard.

assets.name: barn-flame-eave
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animation sprite strip of a SMALL WIDE LOW ROOF-EAVE FIRE, four distinct hand-painted frames. Create one 1536x1024 RGBA image, EXACTLY FOUR 384x1024 cells arranged in ONE horizontal row. Within each cell the same LOW WIDE cluster of three interlocking flame tongues fits x=35..349 and y=450..760, fixed fire foot point (192,760); every margin including bottom 220 pixels is genuine alpha. Do not draw a tall single candle flame. Each cluster is about 300 pixels wide and 260 pixels high.

Style: sharp fine ink outlines and painterly 2D cel-shaded fighting-game effects matching a rustic rainy-dusk wooden barn, burnt-orange outer flame, orange middle and small bright pale-yellow cores. Intricate pointed flame curls; NO bloom, haze, colored background, smoke, floor, architecture, logs, stones, text, labels, numerals, borders, cell guides or watermark. Four sequential newly-painted animation instants of the SAME small fire, changing its internal curls and silhouette without moving its base. Frame 1 central tongue low, left tongue forks upward and right curls inward. Frame 2 central tongue forks, left shrinks, right straightens. Frame 3 right tongue forks, center hooks left, left regrows. Frame 4 left regains its original height, right settles inward, returning seamlessly to frame 1. All frames similar width, height, volume and brightness. Distinct real drawings, never rotated, recolored, translated, stretched, mirrored or duplicate frames. Small sparks can lift but stay inside each cell. True transparent background, not a painted checkerboard.

assets.name: barn-flame-door
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: hand-painted 2D game animation strip, a narrow hayloft fire. Produce a 1536x1024 PNG with a truly transparent background and EXACTLY FOUR separated 384x1024 cells in one horizontal row. Each cell contains one small cluster of orange and yellow pointed flames. Fixed centerline x=192 within cell, baseline y=760, maximum width 230px, height 320px; all four feet precisely aligned. No smoke, architecture, wood, shadows, text, border, cell markings, numbers, floor or background.

Paint four genuinely different animation frames of a flickering fire, as crisp dark-outlined painterly cel art. Distinct and deliberate progression: frame 1 TWO equal narrow tongues, left curling outward left, right curling outward right; frame 2 THREE shorter tongues, the tallest at center, outer two flowing inward; frame 3 ONE tall central forked tongue with two tiny foot curls; frame 4 TWO asymmetric tongues, tall right hooked left and very short left hooked right. Each frame must visibly differ in silhouette and internal flame contour; NEVER duplicate first frame as last frame, never mirror, recolor, stretch or transform a pose. Same palette/width/brightness throughout, same anchored foot; frame 4 should still flow naturally back toward frame 1. Amber orange outlines with yellow cores; mildly brush-textured flame tips, no photorealism, no 3D, no glow halos, no bloom, no soft orange blobs. Broad empty transparent margins separate each sprite and surround whole sheet.
